patterns.note: The site employs a fixed, full-page background grid over which all primary content sections scroll, creating a layered depth effect.
A persistent right-hand vertical navigation bar acts as a scroll progress indicator, highlighting the current section as the user moves down the page.
A distinct monospaced font is used for body text and labels, contrasting with a more traditional sans-serif for prominent headings, contributing to a 'document' or 'blueprint' aesthetic.
A dominant, deep green is used for branding, accents, and interactive elements, set against a palette of muted greys and a lighter, desaturated green for background details.
The main content scrolls vertically over a fixed, full-page background featuring a grid of circles and vertical lines, creating a layered effect.
A right-hand vertical navigation bar remains sticky in the viewport, highlighting the active section as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: The page utilizes a fixed background element that covers the entire viewport, over which all primary content sections scroll. A separate, fixed-position navigation element on the right side of the screen updates its active state based on the scroll position, indicating the current section.

Content sections are structured with generous vertical padding, often using a lighter background color to visually separate them from the main fixed background. Text blocks are typically left-aligned, with occasional centered elements for calls to action or illustrations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, distinct headings (approx. 3-4x body) with small, often uppercase, monospaced body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle, primarily sharp with minor rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: airy overall due to generous vertical spacing between sections and a fixed background, but with balanced to dense text blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the 'blueprint' or 'document' aesthetic, achieved through a fixed, full-page grid background and a prominent right-hand sticky navigation that functions like a table of contents or progress tracker. This gives the site a unique, structured, and almost archival feel.
